summary: Full regression + Prompt 3 frontend E2E. Backend: existing 89/89 pytest tests pass (17.76s). New endpoint tests file /app/backend/tests/test_new_endpoints.py — 2/2 pass covering GET /school/students/stats (all 6 keys returned, cross-tenant counts isolated), GET /school/students/{id}/timeline (list + 404 for foreign tenant), and GET /school/guardians/{id}/students (embedded student + 404 foreign tenant). Frontend: KPI cards (kpi-total/active/new/missing) render with live values; filters (filter-status/class/year/sort), search (students-search), and New-student dialog (btn-new-student → st-first/last/dob/gender/class/section/ay → st-submit) work end-to-end and refresh both list and KPIs (kpi-total went 0→1 after create). Student detail loads with all 6 tabs (stab-overview/academic/guardians/documents/enrollments/timeline). student-status-select + Apply present. Guardians tab shows btn-link-guardian; dialog exposes link-guardian-select + link-submit. Timeline tab renders audit event 'student.create'. Enrollments dialog exposes btn-new-enrollment + en-year/en-class/en-section/en-roll/en-submit (verified in source). Guardian detail (/school/guardians/{id}) exposes guardian-detail + guardian-students. Family detail (/school/families/{id}) exposes family-detail + family-students + family-guardians. Cross-tenant isolation confirmed at API level for students, timeline, and guardian-students endpoints.

issues: TableRow with data-testid='student-row-{admission_number}' has no onClick handler — only the admission-number and name cells are Link-wrapped. Clicking row body outside these cells does nothing. Consider wrapping whole row or adding onClick={() => navigate(...)}

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Naming: test spec references enrollment-ay/enrollment-class/enrollment-submit but implementation uses en-year/en-class/en-submit. Both work; align only if the spec is authoritative.
(Optional UX) Make entire student row clickable, not just admission#/name cells.
critical_code_review_comments: student_stats endpoint counts missing_dob and missing_guardians separately then sums for missing_info — a student missing BOTH will be double-counted. Consider using $or in a single query or set-union.
student_timeline query builds $or with resource_id:{$in: enroll_ids} even when enroll_ids is []; Mongo handles this fine but explicit guard would be clearer.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of listed data-testids present and interactive

test_credentials: Fresh per-run tenants via POST /api/v1/auth/register-school (see test_credentials.md). Sample used: owner+e2e{ts}@example.com / Owner@1234.
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own throwaway tenant; no shared fixtures modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3 new read endpoints (stats/timeline/guardian_students) are covered in /app/backend/tests/test_new_endpoints.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_new_endpoints.py`. Pagination controls (page-prev/page-next/page-info) not exercised at 25+ scale — code path exists and shows only when totalPages>1. Guardian double-counting caveat in stats aggregation is a minor semantic concern.
